Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.audio

Class OpenAISpeechProvider

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.audio.OpenAISpeechProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
SpeechProvider
public final class OpenAISpeechProvider extends Object implements SpeechProvider
The sole production narration provider. Sends text to OpenAI's HTTPS Speech API and requests WAV. Configuration is snapshotted per job; credentials never enter cache keys or diagnostics. No automatic retries: a failed request must not silently create additional billable requests.
